name: Delhi liquor vends with complete approximate coordinates

metadata.scope: Official published listings from DSCSC and DCCWS. DTTDC and DSIIDC full current lists are not included.
metadata.official_total_context: Delhi Excise reports 712 L-6/L-10 licensees in 2024-25, so this file is expanded but not complete.
metadata.geometry_note: Official source pages do not publish latitude/longitude. Features therefore use null geometry; no coordinates were invented.
metadata.osm_matching_policy: Coordinates were attached to an official record only where the name/address match was high confidence. Other exact OSM points remain standalone to avoid false one-to-one assignments.
metadata.osm_coverage_warning: This is not a complete OpenStreetMap extract. Community mapping coverage is incomplete and can change.
metadata.coordinate_fill_policy: Existing OSM points were retained. Official records without coordinates were assigned the centre of the named locality, sector, neighbourhood, mall area or closest interpretable parent area.
metadata.important_accuracy_warning: 373 official records use approximate area-centre coordinates and must not be treated as storefront, building, parcel, routing or enforcement locations.
